Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    row_cuts = [-1] + divider_rows + [h]

    row_spans = [(row_cuts[i] + 1, row_cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_cuts) - 1)]
    col_spans = [(col_cuts[i] + 1, col_cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_cuts) - 1)]
    # Most frequent color is the panel background; dividers are excluded by spans.
    from collections import Counter

    divider_r = set(divider_rows)
    divider_c = set(divider_cols)
    interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                if r not in divider_r and c not in divider_c]
    background = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[background for _ in col_spans] for _ in row_spans]
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_spans):
            markers = sum(grid[r][c] != background
                          for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            if markers == 2:
                out[ri][ci] = 1
    return out


if __name__ == '__main__':
    demo = [[5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,4,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],
            [5,5,5,5,7,4,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],

            [5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5],
            [5,5,5,5,7,5,5,5,5,7,5,5,4,4,7,4,5,5,5]]
    assert transform(demo) == [[5, 5, 5, 5], [5, 5, 1, 5]]
    test = [[7,7,3,2,7,7,7,2,7,7,7,2,7,7,7,2,7,7,7],
            [7,7,7,2,7,3,7,2,7,3,7,2,7,3,7,2,7,3,3],

            [7,3,7,2,7,3,7,2,7,7,7,2,7,7,7,2,7,7,7],
            [2]*19,
            [7,3,7,2,7,7,7,2,3,7,7,2,7,3,7,2,7,7,7],
            [7,7,7,2,7,7,3,2,7,7,3,2,7,7,7,2,7,3,7]]
    print(transform(demo))
    print(transform(test))
    assert transform(test) == [[7,7,7,7,1], [7,1,7,7,7], [7,7,1,7,7]]
    print('verified')
